# Native route gap capture

The anonymous Apex probes in this directory were captured in a fresh Developer scratch org with a 30-day duration and no features or settings. The org was deleted and its absence verified through the Dev Hub. `org.tsv` transcribes framed assertion messages. Each probe includes Account and a synthetic missing-object control. The first SOSL observation covers API 68 only; the later capture below records the other versions.

A second fresh 30-day Developer scratch org captured the previously unobserved anonymous Apex APIs 63, 65 and 66 and SOSL APIs 62 through 67 using the same sources and controls. That org was also deleted and its absence verified through the hub.
